ios.desc:
Stop doomscrolling before another hour disappears.
Most blockers just lock you out and get bypassed in seconds. SmartScroll is different: when your limit is reached on Tiktok, Reels, Shorts, or any endless feed, it interrupts the loop and replaces it with quick knowledge cards. Something better to do, right at the moment your brain wants "one more video."

Why people use SmartScroll:

- Interrupt doomscrolling before it spirals
- Block TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, X, and more after daily limits are reached
- Replace mindless scrolling with bite-sized knowledge you’ll actually remember
- Add friction when automatic scrolling takes over
- Visualize wasted screen time with Life Grid
- Build healthier phone habits without deleting social media

Core features:

- Automatic app blocking after your limits are reached
- Smart interruption flow that breaks scrolling momentum
- Bite-sized knowledge cards for quick, useful learning
- Custom app limits and schedules
- Life Grid to visualize time lost and time reclaimed

SmartScroll is for people who:

- Open social media without thinking
- Lose an hour checking “one thing”
- Feel mentally drained after short-form videos
- Have tried timers, willpower, or basic blockers without success
• Want healthier phone habits without quitting social media

Your apps are not the problem.
The automatic scrolling loop is.
SmartScroll helps you break it.

Download SmartScroll for free.
Premium features require an in-app purchase.
